target_domain_description: Telugu-English code-mixed text about sports, including sports news, cricket, football, match results, players, teams, tournaments, scores, sports opinions, and fan experiences.
similarity_method: Maximum cosine similarity across multiple target-domain references, contrasted against general-conversation reference similarity.
interpretation: The score estimates the proportion of records whose target-domain similarity meets the selected threshold and exceeds general-conversation similarity by the required margin. It is a semantic relevance proxy, not proof of population representativeness.
limitations: Thresholds and relevance margins are provisional.
Embedding similarity can be affected by short text, slang, transliteration, dialect, and code-mixing.
The general-conversation references are a contrast baseline, not a definitive negative class.
Human review is required to validate classifications.
This metric does not prove population representativeness or complete coverage of domain subtopics.
